verdicts.reason: A is a shrunk copy of the original. The SOLSTICE logo and the '25% off' line are microscopic, the CTA label is barely readable, the headline leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line, and there is dead space above the logo and between the CTA and the legal text. B makes good use of the tall format and its headline and CTA are clearly legible, but the headline breaks into one word per line (the word 'the' sits alone), the tiny logo is pushed against the top edge, the ribbon crowds the phone, and the bottom stack of offer line, CTA and legal text is cramped against the bottom edge.
